items.source: Returns the base packages to scan for Elasticsearch mapped entities at startup. Will return the package name of the configuration class' (the concrete class, not this one here) by default. So if you have a com.acme.AppConfig extending ElasticsearchConfigurationSupport the base package will be considered com.acme unless the method is overridden to implement alternate behavior.
items.translation: 返回在启动时用于扫描 Elasticsearch 映射实体的基础包。默认情况下，将返回配置类（即具体类，而非此处所示的此类）的包名。因此，如果您有一个继承自 ElasticsearchConfigurationSupport 的 com.acme.AppConfig 类，则基础包将被视为 com.acme，除非重写此方法以实现其他行为。

items.source:
Flag specifiying if type hints (_class fields) should be written in the index. It is strongly advised to keep the
default value of true. If you need to write to an existing index that does not have a mapping defined
for these fields and that has a strict mapping set, then it might be necessary to disable type hints. But notice
that in this case reading polymorphic types may fail.
items.translation: 指定是否应在索引中写入类型提示（_class 字段）的标志。强烈建议保持默认值 true。如果您需要向一个尚未为这些字段定义映射且设置了严格映射的现有索引写入数据，则可能需要禁用类型提示。但请注意，在这种情况下，读取多态类型可能会失败。
